data.body:
LANDED, but NOT closing: the last acceptance criterion needs an operator-dispatched live run.

Change 1653 merged as b13173bb7d (Gerrit rebased it server-side; LLM-Review +1 from rebar-review-bot, Verified +1 from rebar-ci-bot, 0 unresolved comments). Confirmed mirrored to GitHub main, so a live dispatch now includes the fix.

ACs 1-5 verified against merged HEAD and checked off in the description:
1. no OK: assertion remains in test_reconcile_pass.py; _assert_converged_writing_pass and _assert_wrote_nothing now go through converged_pass_problem / wrote_nothing_problem.
2. no __main__.py:NNN citations remain in the file (the stale :444, :456 and :445-452 references are all gone; replacements name run_differs.py / applier.py / docs/exit-codes.md instead of line numbers, which is what rotted in the first place).
3. pytest tests/unit/test_bridge_output_parsing.py = 11 passed with JIRA_PAT / JIRA_PROJECT / JIRA_DC_BASE_URL unset; _bridge_output.py imports only 're'.
4. both cells still present and enabled, no xfail anywhere in the file, only the pre-existing @_skip / @_skip_no_extra credential guards.
5. make lint and make typecheck clean in the worktree venv after the server-side rebase.

AC6 is deliberately left unchecked. It requires a Live External Integration run on main showing both DC cells green, and that lane cannot be exercised from this session. I also did not self-dispatch it: external-integration.yml runs every credentialed provider on EVERY trigger and its own header notes the volume makes the spend material, so firing the full matrix is an operator spend decision rather than an agent one.

Exact dispatch command when the operator wants the re-green:

    gh workflow run "Live External Integration" --ref main

Expected result: tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_reconcile_pass.py::test_a_repeated_dc_reconcile_pass_writes_nothing and ::test_a_dc_created_ticket_carries_the_shared_jira_provenance both PASS, with the DC harness back to 0 failed. Note the third failure in run 31362329118 (test_dc_mutations.py::test_outbound_create_stamps_both_provenance_markers, 'git timed out after 30s') was runner I/O contention, not an assertion defect, and is out of scope here; if it recurs it needs its own ticket rather than being folded into this one.

Ticket stays in_progress pending that run.
